candidate_reports.remark: Mesonet station EW9464 Banner Elk.
Mesonet station DVI014137 Taterhill.
Mesonet station EW9464 Banner Elk.
Large tree down on Midland Trail.
A personal weather station recorded a storm-total of 5.85 inches of rainfall. Runoff from this rain enters the Middle Fork South Fork New River.
A personal weather station recorded a storm total amount of 9.08 inches of rain. Runoff from this rain entered the Watauga River.

The Watauga River at Aldridge Road near the community of Banner Elk crested at a stage of 9.0 feet_ which is moderate flood stage. Multiple low water bridges downstream of the gage were observed inundated by flooding.

Dutch Creek at Broadstone Road (WDCN7) crested at 8.16 feet above the moderate flood stage of 8.0 feet. This resulted in flooding across Broadstone Road. A vehicle was reported stranded in the flooding_ with the occupants able to abandon the vehicle for higher ground.
Delayed Report: Walnut Avenue was closed due to flooding at the bridge at Tinker Creek in Roanoke_ VA.
The Watauga River at Foscoe (FOSN7) crested at a stage of 10.37 feet above the minor flood stage of 9 feet. Portions of a nearby golf course were flooded.
Vehicle stuck in flooded road near the intersection of Broadstone Road and NC Highway 105 South next to Watauga River.
The SF New River at SR 1100 near Brownwood (SFBN7) crested at 11.56 feet above the minor flood stage of 10 feet.
Event total rainfall.
Vehicle stuck in flooded road on Highway 221 Business near West Jefferson.
Social media post shared photo of flooded bridge on Dewitt Barnett Road over the Watauga River.

The Watauga River near Sugar Grove (SGWN7) crested at a stage of 10.31 feet (5_607 cfs) above the minor flood stage of 6 feet. This crest has a 2-year average recurrence interval per USGS StreamStats.
Washed out road reported on Blue Bend Road south of its intersection with Jamestown Road.
Event total rainfall since 7 AM 10/10/2026.

Social media post photo showed South Fork New River over Rustic Road. A bridge under construction was destroyed with a John Deere excavator partially submerged. Tree trunks_ branches_ and pieces of wood were also on the river.
A personal weather station recorded as storm total rainfall amount of 8.63 inches rainfall. Runoff from this rain enters the Watauga River.
Event total rainfall.
Basement flooding reported at residential address near the intersection of Cherry Lane and Rakestone Road.
Event total precipitation.

The South Fork New River near Jefferson (JFRN7) crested at a stage of 9.21 feet (9_080 cfs) above the minor flood stage of 8 feet. This crest has between a 5-year and a 10-year annual recurrence interval per USGS StreamStats.
